data.desc: Sweetgreen (NYSE: SG) believes good taste starts long before the first bite. Since 2007, the brand has been on a mission to create healthy communities by connecting people to real food. Its longstanding relationships with farmers bring seasonal ingredients to its kitchens, where teams cook from scratch every day. The result is a fresh, flavorful approach to fast casual that makes eating well something to look forward to. Today, sweetgreen offers its farm-sourced, chef-crafted menus at 289 locations across the country.
